description: Deltares Global Flood Maps is a dataset listed in Microsoft Planetary Computer data catalogue, a cloud catalogue of environmental and geospatial data sets, published or maintained by Deltares. Deltares has produced inundation maps of flood depth using a model that takes into account water level attenuation and is forced by sea level. At the coastline, the model is forced by extreme water levels containing surge and tide from GTSMip6. Coverage: global coastal flood depth maps for 2018 and 2050. The catalogue entry lists assets named data, index, reachable through the STAC API. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CDLA-Permissive-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure exposure, hazard and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-planetary-computer-catalogue.
